The Tenno Sho (Autumn)... an unseen 
autumn. Stepping onto a completely new 
path, she stands against――

Zenno Rob Roy aims for the Autumn Senior 
Triple Crown. If Neo Universe wins, that 
dream will be thwarted. Even so, the hero 
smiles, declaring, "Bring it on."

As the two clashed, a new historical 
chapter was about to be written.
